title: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken
description: Bright and zesty grilled chicken with fresh herbs.
steps: Combine lemon juice, zest, olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper.
Marinate chicken for 15 minutes.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Grill chicken 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
description: Silky pasta tossed in a rich mushroom cream sauce.
steps: Cook pasta until al dente.
Sauté mushrooms in butter until browned.
Add garlic and cook briefly.
Pour in cream and simmer until slightly thickened.
Toss with pasta and parmesan; season to taste.

title: Avocado Toast Deluxe
description: Crispy toast topped with smashed avocado and extras.
steps: Toast bread to your liking.
Mash avocado with lemon, salt, and pepper.
Spread on toast, top with chili flakes.

title: Teriyaki Salmon Bowl
description: Glazed salmon served over rice with veggies.
steps: Whisk soy, mirin, and sugar to make teriyaki.
Pan-sear salmon; pour sauce and reduce.
Steam broccoli.
Serve salmon over rice with broccoli and sesame.

title: Mediterranean Salad
description: Crisp veggies with olives and feta in lemon dressing.
steps: Chop vegetables and olives.
Whisk dressing ingredients.
Toss with feta and serve chilled.
